derivedSurfaces.name: led-diffuser
derivedSurfaces.notes: Dark unlit RGB LED diffuser from exact product photograph. No fabricated lit pattern or firmware pixels.

referencePhotos.cropNotes: Fixed documented ROI excludes unrelated cable/coin/packaging; original source is retained.

referencePhotos.notes: Official lit pattern used only for geometry/axes reference, never as firmware pixels.

textures.notes: Explicit paper-only original-photo pixel mask; no case material, connector, hole or screen photo included.
textures.method: Fixed axis-aligned crop; original-coordinate explicit alpha ROI at4x supersampling when alphaMask supplied; exclusions remove fasteners/holes/shell. No generated pixels or perspective warp.

tessellation.step: OpenCascade 7.8.1.1; absolute deflection0.05mm, angle0.2rad, native solids plus orphan shells/faces; units converted by STEP reader to millimetres

provenance.photoRights: Official product photographs copyright M5Stack / named manufacturer. No separate open photo license verified; retained for product reference, not relicensed under project MIT.

limitations: Several official photo URLs contained unescaped spaces and initially failed; only available evidence is used until those source downloads are repaired.

25 diffuser light spots use actual G27 RMT values. Pitch and optical shape are photo estimates; no reconstructed internal LED PCB. Official factory stays in Wi-Fi scan; complete test, IR and physical wireless not verified.
